descriptive_title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Algebra — Variables, Equivalent Expressions, and Equivalent Relationships for Whole Numbers to 1000 (C2.1-C2.3)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Grade-3 unit on Algebra (C2.1-C2.3) framed around 'Balanced Equations' — Eddy the Equation Engineer and Vex the Variable Vet. Variables, equivalence across all 4 operations, and a capstone balance puzzle.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Equation Engineers. Day 1 introduces variables in real contexts including unknowns and varying values (C2.1). Day 2 tests addition/subtraction equivalence (C2.2). Day 3 tests multiplication/division equivalence (C2.2). Day 4 hunts equivalent relationships for whole numbers up to 1000 across all 4 operations (C2.3). Day 5 closes with child-invented balance puzzles. Each lesson includes an expanded_walkthrough.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson

10 printable teacher manipulatives plus 2 character puppets: variable chart, big balance scale mat, addition/subtraction cards (24), multiplication/division cards (24), equivalent-target cards (12), capstone template, two-colour counters, number line to 1000, equation anchor chart, engineer poster, plus stick-puppet variants of Eddy and Vex
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 three-row summative rubric covering C2.1-C2.3 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 capstone
Junior Equation Engineer certificate (one per child)
Detailed expanded walkthroughs covering common misconceptions
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 3 teachers covering the C2.1-C2.3 cluster — variables, equivalence, and equivalent relationships to 1000.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: CRA progression. The big balance scale mat and number line to 1000 are anchors. Lesson 1 conceptualises variables. Lessons 2-3 test equivalence within/across operations. Lesson 4 generalises to many ways for big targets. Lesson 5 closes with capstone integrating all three expectations.
